Only one lecture is held in each session, and the morning session comes before the evening session. Each of them is from a different city — Indore, Ranchi, Lucknow, Mumbai, Shimla, Jaipur, Kochi and Delhi.

1. Only two persons have lectures between Zoya and the one who is from Mumbai.
2. The one who is from Ranchi has a lecture after Fatima.
3. Only one person has a lecture between the one who is from Ranchi and Zoya.
4. Only one person has a lecture between the one who is from Indore and the one who is from Kochi, and the one who is from Indore has a lecture after the one who is from Kochi.
5. Anjali is from Jaipur.
6. Only one person has a lecture between Fatima and Rahul, and Fatima has a lecture after Rahul.
7. Only two persons have lectures between Leela and the one who is from Delhi.
8. Joseph is from Indore.
9. Yamini has a lecture immediately before Zoya.
10. The one who is from Jaipur has a lecture on Friday morning.
11. Yamini is from Shimla.
12. Neither Yamini nor the one who is from Kochi has a lecture on Tuesday.
